project_type: Spring Boot 3.2.5 + H2 in-memory DB + Tailwind CSS (CDN) single-page frontend. No Lombok — manual getters/setters everywhere. No MapStruct. Springdoc not yet added.
build_system: Maven. spring-boot-maven-plugin configured. run.bat uses a local .tools path — use mvn directly.
test_framework: spring-boot-starter-test (JUnit 5). Tests in src/test/java/com/college/library/LibraryManagementApplicationTests.java. 3 passing integration tests.
verification_instructions: 1. Run mvn compile — expect BUILD SUCCESS, zero errors. 2. Run mvn test — all 3 existing tests pass (context loads, fine calculation, issue-return workflow). 3. Optionally mvn spring-boot:run and visit http://localhost:8081.
environment_constraints: Server port 8081 (not 8080). H2 console at /h2-console. No external DB — H2 in-memory. Windows OS — always quote paths with spaces in shell commands.
contribution_requirements: No Lombok — every new field needs manual getter and setter. No MapStruct — entities serialized directly. @CrossOrigin(origins='*') already on all controller classes, new methods inherit it. Declare every new service method in the interface before implementing. Backend must compile cleanly after every FEAT commit.
key_patterns: Controllers: @RestController, @RequestMapping, @CrossOrigin(origins='*') at class level, constructor injection, ResponseEntity<T>. Services: interface in service/, impl in service/impl/ with @Service @Transactional. Entities extend BaseEntity (id/createdAt/updatedAt). DTOs in dto/ (plain Java, no annotations except Bean Validation). Repositories extend JpaRepository<T,Long>. Frontend: allBooksCache/allMembersCache/allTransactionsCache for last-fetched data. renderXTable(list) populates tbody. openModal/closeModal helpers. showToast(msg, isError). escapeHtml() for XSS. handleXSubmit(e) for form submits. fetch() with async/await, throw on !res.ok.
directory_structure: src/main/java/com/college/library/ root package. Sub-packages: entity/, repository/, service/ (interfaces) + service/impl/ (impls), controller/, dto/ (IssueRequest, ReturnRequest, ReturnResponse, DashboardStats), exception/ (GlobalExceptionHandler, ResourceNotFoundException, BookNotAvailableException), config/ (DataInitializer). Frontend: src/main/resources/static/ — index.html, js/app.js, css/style.css.
